mission.title: llm-d: Create a new llm-d repository to host inference server API extensions
mission.description: Create a new llm-d repository to host inference server API extensions. Community-requested feature.

steps.title: Check current llm-d deployment
steps.description:
Verify your llm-d version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n llm-d -l app.kubernetes.io/name=llm-d
helm list -n llm-d 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working llm-d installation.

steps.title: Review llm-d configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant llm-d configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n llm-d -l app.kubernetes.io/name=llm-d
kubectl get configmap -n llm-d -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=llm-d
```
[RFC](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/38147) was opened in vLLM to create endpoints to retrieve data to be used by llm-d for routing, scheduling etc.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Create a new llm-d repository to host inference server API…
steps.description:
This repo has been created, but it is bare-bone. Please make sure that it has the following files added ASAP:
- CONTRIBUTING.md
-  MAINTAINERS.md
- OWNERS
- SECURITY.md
- .gitignore (appropriate for the codebase)

For proper examples, you can look in this or other llm-d repos.

See the source issue for community-verified solutions.

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n llm-d -l app.kubernetes.io/name=llm-d
kubectl get events -n llm-d --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Create a new llm-d repository to host inference server API…" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary:
This repo has been created, but it is bare-bone. Please make sure that it has the following files added ASAP:
- CONTRIBUTING.md
-  MAINTAINERS.md
- OWNERS
- SECURITY.md
- .gitignore (appropriate for the codebase)

For proper examples, you can look in this or other llm-d repos.

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with llm-d installed or the issue environment reproducible.
